name: Automatic Spray Gluing Machine
summary: Sprays glue evenly onto the target object, suitable for larger-sized panels. High spraying efficiency and strong compatibility, from 75" to full-size compatibility.
contentHtml:
The automatic spray gluing machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for large-panel glue spraying needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a glue block melter feeding method, heating and melting solid glue blocks, then spraying them evenly onto the product surface through a nozzle. Fast spraying speed and uniform coating.

Technical Advantages

  • Spraying speed of 0.6-0.8m/s, industry-leading efficiency
  • Compatible sizes from 75" to full size, wide application range
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ASM-01/02/03 available
  • Can be paired with vision or mechanical positioning
